title: Inspect EUR title animation sequence-zero producers
changes: Separate the known selector-one title animation bank from a distinct selector-zero bank and document the limits of the producer scan.
validation: Wine e155-title-sequence-zero-dis-wine-f4_b2apw confirms two direct initializer calls use different bank roots and selectors; an exact EUR aligned literal/direct-call scan is bounded to its stated forms.
Focused Sol consultation requested gpt-6.1-sol xhigh; effective settings are not independently verifiable.
limitations: No ordinary sequence-zero producer for the first bank is established; indirect calls, computed roots, mutable animator fields and other scenes remain open. Linux, USA and native Windows pending. No performance measurement.
